verdict.rationale: Statsig's own docs describe a Scheduled Rollout feature for Feature Gates that deploys a feature gradually over time, so time-based release scheduling is a first-party capability. The evidence does not show that arbitrary flag changes can be set to fire at a specific future date and time; it only covers gradual rollout progression. missing for 10: explicit scheduling of arbitrary flag/config changes at a chosen future timestamp, documentation of schedule configuration details (start time, steps, timezone), scheduling via API/CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule flag changes and releases to happen at a specific future time

citations.quote: Gradually deploy a feature over time by setting up a Feature Gate as a Scheduled Rollout.
Schedule gradual feature rollouts to safely deploy new code
